title: Spider Veins vs Varicose Veins: When Laser Helps
h1: Spider veins vs varicose veins: which ones laser can treat
desc: Spider veins vs varicose veins: how they look, when they need a vascular check, and when Nd:YAG laser (AED 1,000 + VAT) is the right treatment. From Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Spider veins are fine red, blue or purple lines just under the skin and are a cosmetic concern that laser treats well (AED 1,000 + VAT at Skin & Laser). Varicose veins are larger, raised, twisted veins, often with aching or swelling, and need a vascular assessment because they can reflect a circulation problem.
body:
## Causes

Genetics, hormones, pregnancy, standing for long periods and sun damage all play a part. Facial spider veins are also linked to rosacea and sun exposure.

## How laser treats spider veins

A long-pulsed Nd:YAG laser heats the vessel until it collapses, and the body clears it over 4 to 8 weeks. Most people need 1 to 3 sessions.

## When to see a vascular specialist

- Bulging veins
- Leg aching, heaviness or swelling
- Skin colour changes or sores near the ankle
- Veins that are painful or warm
faq: Can spider veins turn into varicose veins?
Not directly, but both can share causes, and some people have both.
Laser suits fine veins and the face; sclerotherapy is often used for larger leg veins.
Treated veins usually don't, but new ones can form.
